q23805.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the load fell off by accident, the driver must remove the load, if possible.

explain.short: A fallen load is a danger for everyone. The driver who lost it must take it off the road whenever this is possible.
explain.rule: If your load falls onto the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), you must clear it as fast as you can and, outside towns, warn traffic with the warning triangle.
explain.trap: 'se possibile' (if possible) makes it reasonable: you remove it only when you can do it.

sceneParams.caption: Remove the fallen load if you can

q23806.en: On an extra-urban road, if the carriageway is blocked because the load fell off by accident, the driver must warn of the obstacle in advance with the stopped-vehicle sign (triangle).

explain.short: Outside towns traffic is fast. Other drivers must be warned early, so the driver places the warning triangle behind the fallen load.
explain.rule: If your load falls onto the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), you must clear it as fast as you can and, outside towns, warn traffic with the warning triangle.
explain.trap: 'presegnalare' (warn in advance) with the 'triangolo' is the correct tool, not a STOP sign or the horn.

sceneParams.caption: Warn with the triangle behind the load
lines: Place the warning triangle behind it

keywords.en: warn of the obstacle in advance

q23807.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the load fell off by accident, the driver must quickly free the way for traffic, as far as possible.

explain.short: The fallen load blocks other vehicles. The driver must clear the road quickly, as much as he can.
explain.rule: If your load falls onto the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), you must clear it as fast as you can and, outside towns, warn traffic with the warning triangle.
explain.trap: 'sollecitamente' (quickly) and 'per quanto possibile' (as far as possible): both are part of the real rule.

sceneParams.caption: Free the road quickly, as far as possible

keywords.it: libero, per quanto possibile, il transito
keywords.en: the way free, as far as possible

q23808.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the load fell off by accident, the driver must warn of the obstacle in advance with the STOP sign.

explain.short: A fallen load is signalled with the warning triangle (stopped-vehicle sign). The STOP sign is a road sign for junctions, not a tool for drivers.
explain.rule: If your load falls onto the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), you must clear it as fast as you can and, outside towns, warn traffic with the warning triangle.
explain.trap: 'segnale di STOP' is wrong: the right tool is the 'triangolo' (warning triangle).

sceneParams.caption: Use the warning triangle, not a STOP sign

keywords.en: warn of the obstacle in advance

q23809.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the load fell off by accident, the driver must stay in the vehicle waiting for help.

explain.short: Waiting in the vehicle leaves the danger on the road. The driver must act: clear the road if possible and warn the others.
explain.rule: If your load falls onto the carriageway (carreggiata, the part of the road for vehicles), you must clear it as fast as you can and, outside towns, warn traffic with the warning triangle.
explain.trap: 'restare a bordo' (stay on board) is wrong: the driver must get out (with the vest) and act.

sceneParams.caption: Don't wait inside: clear and warn
lines: Clear the road and warn others

q23810.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the vehicle broke down, the driver must quickly free the way for the traffic coming behind.

explain.short: A broken-down car on the carriageway is a danger for the cars arriving. The driver must free the road as soon as possible.
explain.rule: If your vehicle breaks down or anything blocks the carriageway, you must free the road quickly: push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if you cannot, to its right edge.
explain.trap: 'sollecitamente' (quickly) is correct: there is no waiting.

sceneParams.caption: Free the road quickly for traffic behind
lines: Car broke down on the carriageway

q23811.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the vehicle broke down, the driver must push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if this is not possible, put it at the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: First choice: push the car completely off the carriageway. If you cannot, at least move it to the right edge so others can pass.
explain.rule: If your vehicle breaks down or anything blocks the carriageway, you must free the road quickly: push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if you cannot, to its right edge.
explain.trap: The order matters: 'fuori della carreggiata' first, 'margine destro' only if that is not possible.

sceneParams.caption: Off the carriageway, or to the right edge
lines: If impossible: to the right edge

q23812.en: If the carriageway is blocked by a fallen load or for any other reason, the driver must remove the obstruction, as far as possible.

explain.short: Whatever blocks the road, the driver who caused it must clear it, as much as he can.
explain.rule: If your vehicle breaks down or anything blocks the carriageway, you must free the road quickly: push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if you cannot, to its right edge.
explain.trap: 'per qualsiasi altra causa' (for any other reason): the duty is general, not only for loads.

sceneParams.caption: Remove the obstruction as far as possible
lines: Load or anything blocks the road

q23813.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the vehicle broke down, the driver does not have to move it while waiting for help, if there is little traffic.

explain.short: The duty to free the road does not depend on traffic. Even with few cars, one car arriving fast can crash into it.
explain.rule: If your vehicle breaks down or anything blocks the carriageway, you must free the road quickly: push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if you cannot, to its right edge.
explain.trap: 'se il traffico è scarso' (if traffic is light) is an invented exception.

sceneParams.caption: Move it even if traffic is light
lines: Car broke down on the carriageway

keywords.en: does not have to move it

q23814.en: If the carriageway is blocked because the load fell off by accident, the driver must avoid moving it, so that what happened can be reconstructed correctly.

explain.short: A fallen load is not a crash scene to keep. The priority is safety: the driver must clear the road.
explain.rule: If your vehicle breaks down or anything blocks the carriageway, you must free the road quickly: push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if you cannot, to its right edge.
explain.trap: 'evitare di spostarlo' (avoid moving it) is the opposite of the rule: you must remove it.

sceneParams.caption: Clear the load: safety comes first

q23816.en: On an extra-urban road, if an accident blocks the carriageway with damaged vehicles that cannot be removed, the driver or the passengers must warn of the area in advance with the portable warning triangle.

explain.short: Outside towns other drivers come fast. If the damaged cars cannot be moved, the driver or a passenger places the warning triangle behind them.
explain.rule: If you cannot remove the obstacle (crashed vehicles, a broken-down car, fallen load), you must BOTH warn traffic with the warning triangle AND inform the police.
explain.trap: 'il conducente o i passeggeri' (the driver or the passengers): anyone in the car may place the triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Driver or passenger places the triangle
lines: Driver or passenger places the triangle

q23817.en: If the carriageway is blocked by a broken-down vehicle that cannot be moved, the driver must inform the police, without having to warn of the area in advance.

explain.short: Calling the police is not enough. The driver must also place the warning triangle, because cars arrive before the police.
explain.rule: If you cannot remove the obstacle (crashed vehicles, a broken-down car, fallen load), you must BOTH warn traffic with the warning triangle AND inform the police.
explain.trap: 'senza dover' (without having to): the rule wants BOTH the police call AND the triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Police AND triangle: both are required

keywords.en: without having to warn in advance

q23818.en: If the carriageway is blocked by a fallen load that cannot be removed, the driver may avoid informing the police if he warns of the area with effective hand signals.

explain.short: Hand signals do not replace the police call. If the load cannot be removed, the police must be told.
explain.rule: If you cannot remove the obstacle (crashed vehicles, a broken-down car, fallen load), you must BOTH warn traffic with the warning triangle AND inform the police.
explain.trap: 'può evitare di informare' (may avoid informing): no, informing the police is required.

sceneParams.caption: Hand signals don't replace the police

q23819.en: Anyone who could not avoid dropping or spilling slippery, flammable or otherwise dangerous materials must, among other things, warn of the area with the portable warning sign, even in the middle of the carriageway.

explain.short: A spill can cover the whole road. So the warning triangle may be placed even in the middle of the carriageway, where it is most visible.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'anche in mezzo alla carreggiata' (even in the middle of the carriageway) is correct for spills.

sceneParams.caption: Triangle may go in the middle of the road

keywords.en: even in the middle of the carriageway

q23820.en: On an extra-urban road, anyone who could not avoid dropping or spilling slippery, flammable or otherwise dangerous materials must, among other things, warn of the area with the portable warning sign, placed even in the middle of the carriageway.

explain.short: Outside towns cars are fast and a spill is very dangerous. The warning triangle can be placed even in the middle of the carriageway.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'posto anche in mezzo alla carreggiata' is allowed here, unlike for a normal stopped car.

sceneParams.caption: Spill: triangle even in mid-carriageway

keywords.en: even in the middle of the carriageway

q23821.en: Anyone who could not avoid dropping or spilling dangerous materials must, among other things, make hand signals to stop vehicles passing on the side where the portable warning sign was not placed.

explain.short: The triangle covers one direction only. On the other side, the person makes hand signals to stop the traffic.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'dalla parte dove non è stato posto' (on the side WITHOUT the triangle) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Hand signals on the side without triangle
lines: Hand signals on the other side

q23822.en: Anyone who could not avoid dropping or spilling slippery, flammable or dangerous materials must, among other things, remove them or, if possible, spread sand, earth, sawdust or other suitable material on the ground to restore grip.

explain.short: A slippery road makes cars skid. You remove the material or cover it with sand, earth or sawdust so the tyres grip again.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'ripristinare l'aderenza' (restore grip) is the aim: this is part of the real rule.

sceneParams.caption: Remove it or cover with sand to restore grip

q23823.en: Anyone who could not avoid dropping or spilling dangerous materials must, among other things, make hand signals to warn of the danger only on the side where the portable warning triangle was placed.

explain.short: Hand signals are needed on the OTHER side, where there is no triangle. On the triangle side, the triangle already does the job.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'solo dalla parte dove è stato posto' is the wrong side: hand signals go where there is NO triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Hand signals go on the side WITHOUT triangle
lines: Hand signals on the OTHER side

q23824.en: The driver of a motor vehicle who could not avoid spilling dangerous materials may avoid warning of the area with the portable warning sign if he uses the horn to keep other vehicles away.

explain.short: The horn does not replace the warning triangle. The triangle is always required for a spill.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'può evitare' (may avoid) + 'segnali sonori' (horn): there is no such exception.

sceneParams.caption: The horn does not replace the triangle

q23825.en: Anyone who could not avoid dropping slippery materials must divert the traffic while waiting for the road owner to come and restore normal conditions.

explain.short: The person must act at once: place the triangle, make hand signals and remove or cover the material. Diverting traffic and waiting is not the rule.
explain.rule: If you spill slippery, flammable or dangerous material, you must place the warning triangle (even in the middle of the carriageway), make hand signals on the other side, and remove the material or cover it with sand or earth.
explain.trap: 'deviare il traffico in attesa' (divert traffic and wait) is invented: you must clear or cover the material yourself.

sceneParams.caption: Don't divert and wait: signal and cover it

q23826.en: Outside built-up areas, at night, when the rear position lights or hazard lights are missing or not enough, it is compulsory to warn of the vehicle stopped on the carriageway with the portable warning triangle.

explain.short: At night a stopped car without working rear lights is almost invisible. Outside towns the warning triangle is then compulsory.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' (compulsory) is correct: it is not just advice.

sceneParams.caption: Night, no rear lights: triangle compulsory

q23827.en: Outside built-up areas, at night, it is compulsory to warn with the portable warning triangle of any load that fell from the vehicle onto the carriageway by accident.

explain.short: A fallen load has no lights at all. Outside towns at night it must always be signalled with the warning triangle.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'ogni carico' (any load): at night outside towns there are no exceptions.

sceneParams.caption: Fallen load at night: triangle compulsory

q23828.en: Outside built-up areas, it is compulsory even by day to warn of a vehicle stopped on the carriageway with the warning triangle when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 metres away.

explain.short: By day the triangle is needed when the car is hard to see, for example after a bend or in fog. The limit is 100 m.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'anche di giorno' (even by day) and '100 metri' are both correct.

sceneParams.caption: Not visible at 100 m: triangle even by day

q23829.en: Outside built-up areas it is compulsory, even by day, to warn of a load that fell onto the carriageway by accident with the portable warning triangle, when the obstacle cannot be seen clearly from 100 metres away.

explain.short: The same rule as for a stopped car: if the fallen load is not clearly visible from 100 m, the triangle is required, also by day.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' and '100 metri' are both correct.

sceneParams.caption: Load not visible at 100 m: triangle

q23830.en: The portable warning triangle is part of the compulsory equipment of motor vehicles.

explain.short: Every motor vehicle (car, truck, bus) must carry a warning triangle on board.
explain.rule: The warning triangle goes behind the vehicle or obstacle, at least 50 m away, and must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' is correct: you can be fined if it is missing.

sceneParams.caption: Warning triangle: compulsory on board

q23831.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed behind the vehicle or obstacle to be signalled, at least 50 metres away.

explain.short: The triangle must give drivers time to slow down, so it goes at least 50 m behind the stopped vehicle or obstacle.
explain.rule: The warning triangle goes behind the vehicle or obstacle, at least 50 m away, and must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.trap: 'dietro' (behind) and 'almeno 50 metri' (at least 50 m) are both correct.

sceneParams.caption: Triangle at least 50 m behind

q23832.en: If there is a junction less than 50 metres away, the portable warning triangle must be placed behind the vehicle in the position where it is best seen.

explain.short: If a junction is closer than 50 m, you cannot always keep the 50 m. You put the triangle behind the car where drivers see it best.
explain.rule: The warning triangle goes behind the vehicle or obstacle, at least 50 m away, and must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.trap: 'nella posizione più idonea' (in the most suitable position) is the correct exception near a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Junction near: triangle where best seen

keywords.it: posizione più idonea ad essere avvistato
keywords.en: position where it is best seen

q23833.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway so that arriving vehicles can see it from at least 100 metres away.

explain.short: Drivers must see the triangle early. It must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.rule: The warning triangle goes behind the vehicle or obstacle, at least 50 m away, and must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.trap: 'almeno 100 metri' for visibility is correct (50 m is the distance from the vehicle).

sceneParams.caption: Triangle visible from at least 100 m

q23834.en: Outside built-up areas, at night, when the rear position lights or hazard lights are missing or not enough, it is advisable to warn of the vehicle stopped on the carriageway with the portable warning triangle.

explain.short: In this case the triangle is compulsory, not just advisable.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'consigliabile' (advisable) is wrong: the correct word is 'obbligatorio' (compulsory).

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory, not just advisable

keywords.it: luci posteriori di posizione o di emergenza

q23835.en: The portable warning triangle must be used to warn of a vehicle stopped by a breakdown at night, if the obstacle is not visible from at least 150 metres away.

explain.short: The distance in the rule is 100 m, not 150 m.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: '150 metri' is the wrong number: the rule says 100 m.

sceneParams.caption: The number is 100 m, not 150 m

q23836.en: Outside built-up areas, it is optional, even by day, to warn of a load that fell onto the carriageway by accident with the warning sign, when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 metres away.

explain.short: It is not optional: if the load cannot be seen from 100 m, the triangle is compulsory.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'facoltativo' (optional) is wrong: it is 'obbligatorio'.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory, not optional

q23837.en: At night, when the rear position lights or hazard lights are missing or not enough, it is compulsory to warn of the stopped vehicle with the portable warning triangle also inside built-up areas.

explain.short: The triangle obligation is for roads outside built-up areas. Inside towns there is street lighting and it is not required.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: 'anche nei centri abitati' (also in towns) is wrong: the duty is only outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory only outside towns

q23838.en: At night, when the rear position lights are missing or not enough, it is compulsory to warn of stopped bicycles, mopeds and motorcycles with the portable warning triangle, also inside built-up areas.

explain.short: Bicycles, mopeds and motorcycles do not have to carry the warning triangle. And inside towns it is not compulsory anyway.
explain.rule: Outside towns, a vehicle or a load stopped on the carriageway must be signalled with the warning triangle at night when the rear lights are missing or too weak, and also by day when it cannot be seen clearly from 100 m.
explain.trap: Two errors: 'velocipedi, ciclomotori e motocicli' are exempt, and 'anche nei centri abitati' is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Two-wheelers don't need the triangle

q23839.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed on the load that fell onto the carriageway by accident.

explain.short: A triangle on the load warns too late. It goes behind the obstacle, at least 50 m away.
explain.rule: The warning triangle goes behind the vehicle or obstacle, at least 50 m away, and must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.trap: 'posto sul carico' (placed on the load) is wrong: it goes 'dietro' (behind).

sceneParams.caption: Behind the load, not on it

q23840.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway so that arriving vehicles can see it from at least 50 metres away.

explain.short: Visibility must be at least 100 m. 50 m is the minimum distance between the triangle and the vehicle.
explain.rule: The warning triangle goes behind the vehicle or obstacle, at least 50 m away, and must be visible from at least 100 m.
explain.trap: The number is mixed up: '50 metri' is the distance from the vehicle, visibility is 100 m.

sceneParams.caption: Visible from 100 m, not 50 m

q23841.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed on the lane occupied by the stopped vehicle or the fallen load.

explain.short: The triangle warns the drivers who are heading for the obstacle, so it goes on the same lane as the stopped vehicle or load.
explain.rule: Place the triangle on the lane where the stopped vehicle or the load is, at least 1 m from the outer edge of the carriageway.
explain.trap: 'sulla corsia occupata' (on the occupied lane) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Triangle on the same lane as the vehicle

q23842.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway at least one metre from its outer edge.

explain.short: If the triangle is too near the edge, drivers may not notice it. It goes at least 1 m inside the carriageway.
explain.rule: Place the triangle on the lane where the stopped vehicle or the load is, at least 1 m from the outer edge of the carriageway.
explain.trap: 'almeno un metro dal bordo esterno' (at least 1 m from the outer edge) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: At least 1 m from the outer edge
lines: At least 1 m from the outer edge

q23843.en: On a carriageway with several lanes, the portable warning triangle must be placed on the lane immediately to the left of the stopped vehicle or fallen load.

explain.short: The triangle goes on the lane where the vehicle or load is, not on the lane next to it.
explain.rule: Place the triangle on the lane where the stopped vehicle or the load is, at least 1 m from the outer edge of the carriageway.
explain.trap: 'corsia immediatamente a sinistra' (lane just to the left) is wrong: it is the occupied lane.

sceneParams.caption: On the occupied lane, not the left one
lines: Not the lane to the left

q23844.en: The portable warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway at least one metre from the line separating the directions of travel.

explain.short: The 1 m rule is about the OUTER edge of the carriageway, not the centre line.
explain.rule: Place the triangle on the lane where the stopped vehicle or the load is, at least 1 m from the outer edge of the carriageway.
explain.trap: 'striscia di separazione dei sensi di marcia' (centre line) is wrong: it is the 'bordo esterno' (outer edge).

sceneParams.caption: 1 m from the outer edge, not the centre line

keywords.it: striscia di separazione dei sensi di marcia

q23845.en: While placing the portable warning sign, the driver must make himself visible by wearing the high-visibility reflective vest or braces.

explain.short: A person on the road is hard to see, especially at night. The reflective vest or braces make the driver visible.
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'giubbotto o le bretelle' (vest or braces): either one is fine.

sceneParams.caption: Wear the reflective vest or braces
lines: Driver gets out to place triangle

q23846.en: The high-visibility reflective vest or braces used while placing the portable warning sign must be of an approved type.

explain.short: Not any yellow jacket is good. The vest or braces must be an approved (officially certified) model.
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'di tipo approvato' (approved type) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Vest or braces must be approved

q23847.en: While placing the portable warning sign, the driver must wear the high-visibility vest even if he is on the emergency lanes or in the lay-bys.

explain.short: On the emergency lane (corsia di emergenza) or in a lay-by (piazzola di sosta) fast traffic is very close. The vest is required there too.
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'anche se si trova sulle corsie di emergenza' (even on emergency lanes) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Vest also on emergency lanes and lay-bys

q23848.en: To place the portable warning sign, the driver must not get out of the vehicle and walk on the road without wearing the high-visibility vest.

explain.short: Getting out on the road without the vest is forbidden. Put the vest on first, then get out.
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'vietato... senza indossare' (forbidden without wearing) is correct: vest first.

sceneParams.caption: Vest on before you get out
lines: Then get out of the car
No vest: forbidden on the road

q23849.en: While placing the portable warning sign, using the high-visibility reflective vest or braces is optional.

explain.short: The vest or braces are compulsory, not optional.
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'facoltativo' (optional) is wrong: it is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory, not optional

q23850.en: While placing the portable warning sign, the driver must not wear the high-visibility vest if he is on the emergency lanes or in the lay-bys.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the vest must be worn there too, because fast traffic passes very close.
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'non deve indossare' (must not wear) is the opposite of the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Vest required on emergency lanes too

q23851.en: The driver must wear the high-visibility vest at night, also inside built-up areas, if he has to stop on the carriageway because his vehicle has a fault.

explain.short: The vest obligation applies outside built-up areas. Inside towns it is not compulsory (though it is a good idea).
explain.rule: Outside towns, when you get out to place the warning triangle, you must wear an approved high-visibility reflective vest or braces, also on the emergency lane and in lay-bys.
explain.trap: 'anche nei centri abitati' (also in towns) is wrong: the duty is only outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Vest compulsory only outside towns

q23852.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, bicycles, mopeds and motorcycles under 150 cm3 are not allowed.

explain.short: These vehicles are too slow or too weak for fast roads. The quiz rule bans motorcycles under 150 cm3.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: Learn the official number '150 cm3' for the quiz.

sceneParams.caption: Bikes, mopeds, small motorbikes: banned

q23852.reviewNote: Art. 175 was changed in 2021 (L. 156/2021): thermal motorcycles from 120 cm3 are now allowed if the rider is an adult; official answer kept.

q23853.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, cars that by design cannot reach a speed of at least 80 km/h on level ground are not allowed.

explain.short: Slow vehicles are dangerous on fast roads. Cars must be able to reach at least 80 km/h on the flat.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'almeno 80 km/h' and 'per costruzione' (by design) are correct.

sceneParams.caption: Cars that can't reach 80 km/h: banned

q23854.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, agricultural machines are not allowed.

explain.short: Tractors and farm machines are very slow. They are banned on these fast roads.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'macchine agricole' (farm machines) are always banned here.

sceneParams.caption: Farm machines: banned

q23855.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles with a messy load that is not firmly secured, or that sticks out beyond the allowed limits, are not allowed.

explain.short: At high speed a loose load can fall and cause a crash. Such vehicles are banned.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'carico disordinato e non solidamente assicurato' (messy, not secured load) is a real ban.

sceneParams.caption: Loose or overhanging load: banned

q23856.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles that are not sealed and have an uncovered load are not allowed if they carry materials that can scatter.

explain.short: Sand or gravel blowing off an open truck can hit other cars. These vehicles are banned.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'vietata' is correct: it is a ban, not advice.

sceneParams.caption: Uncovered loose material: banned

q23857.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles whose condition, equipment and tyres may be a danger to traffic are not allowed.

explain.short: A vehicle in bad condition, for example with worn tyres, is dangerous at high speed. It is banned.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'condizioni di uso, equipaggiamento e gommatura' (condition, equipment, tyres): all count.

sceneParams.caption: Unsafe vehicles: banned

q23858.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, buses carrying students are not allowed.

explain.short: School buses are normal buses and can use motorways. There is no such ban.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'autobus per trasporto di studenti' (school buses) are not on the banned list.

sceneParams.caption: School buses are allowed

q23859.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, it is advisable to avoid driving unsealed vehicles with an uncovered load, if they carry materials that can scatter.

explain.short: It is not just advice: these vehicles are banned.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'consigliabile evitare' (advisable to avoid) is wrong: the correct word is 'vietata' (forbidden).

sceneParams.caption: Banned, not just advisable

q23860.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles carrying live animals are not allowed.

explain.short: Trucks carrying animals in the right way can use motorways. Only animals walking free on the road are banned.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'veicoli che trasportano animali vivi' (vehicles carrying animals) are allowed; free animals are not.

sceneParams.caption: Vehicles carrying animals are allowed

q23861.en: Mopeds that reach a speed of at least 50 km/h are allowed on motorways and main extra-urban roads.

explain.short: Mopeds (ciclomotori) are always banned on these roads, whatever their speed.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'almeno 50 km/h' is a fake condition: mopeds are banned in any case.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds are always banned

q23862.en: Agricultural machines not pulling a trailer are allowed on motorways and main extra-urban roads.

explain.short: Farm machines are banned on these roads, with or without a trailer.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'non trainanti un rimorchio' (not pulling a trailer) is a fake exception.

sceneParams.caption: Farm machines banned, trailer or not

q23863.en: Vehicles without pneumatic tyres are allowed on motorways and main extra-urban roads, if insured.

explain.short: Vehicles without pneumatic (air-filled) tyres are banned. Insurance does not change this.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads these are banned: bicycles, mopeds, small motorcycles, cars that cannot reach 80 km/h, farm machines, vehicles without pneumatic tyres, and unsafe or badly loaded vehicles.
explain.trap: 'se assicurati' (if insured) is a fake condition: insurance has nothing to do with it.

sceneParams.caption: No pneumatic tyres: banned even if insured

q23864.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, pedestrians and animals are not allowed, except in service areas and rest areas.

explain.short: People and animals on a fast road are in great danger. Only in service areas and rest areas may they move about.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads pedestrians and animals are banned, except in service areas and rest areas (animals only if kept under control).
explain.trap: 'ad eccezione delle aree di servizio' (except service areas) is the correct exception.

sceneParams.caption: Only in service and rest areas

q23865.en: In the service areas and rest areas of motorways and main extra-urban roads, animals may move about only if properly kept under control.

explain.short: In service areas animals are allowed, but only under control, for example on a lead.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads pedestrians and animals are banned, except in service areas and rest areas (animals only if kept under control).
explain.trap: 'solo se debitamente custoditi' (only if properly kept) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Animals only if kept under control
lines: Only on a lead / under control

q23866.en: Along the emergency lanes of motorways, pedestrians may walk only to reach the emergency call points.

explain.short: If your car breaks down, you may walk on the emergency lane only to reach an SOS phone point.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads pedestrians and animals are banned, except in service areas and rest areas (animals only if kept under control).
explain.trap: 'solo per raggiungere i punti per le richieste di soccorso' (only to reach SOS points) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Walk only to reach the SOS point
lines: Walk only to the SOS point

q23867.en: On a motorway, towing broken-down vehicles on carriageways, ramps, junctions, service or parking areas is allowed only to authorised rescue vehicles.

explain.short: Towing with a private car on a motorway is dangerous. Only authorised tow trucks (rescue vehicles) may do it.
explain.rule: On motorways only authorised rescue vehicles may tow a broken-down vehicle; a friend's car may not.
explain.trap: 'solo ai veicoli di soccorso autorizzati' (only authorised rescue vehicles) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Only authorised tow trucks may tow

q23868.en: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, pedestrians and animals are not allowed, even in service areas and rest areas.

explain.short: Service areas and rest areas are the exception: there pedestrians and controlled animals may move about.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads pedestrians and animals are banned, except in service areas and rest areas (animals only if kept under control).
explain.trap: 'anche nelle aree di servizio' (even in service areas) is wrong: these areas are the exception.

sceneParams.caption: Service and rest areas are the exception
lines: Motorway: no pedestrians on the road

q23869.en: In the service areas and rest areas of motorways and main extra-urban roads, animals may not move about even if properly kept under control.

explain.short: In these areas animals are allowed if kept under control, for example on a lead.
explain.rule: On motorways and main extra-urban roads pedestrians and animals are banned, except in service areas and rest areas (animals only if kept under control).
explain.trap: 'neppure se debitamente custoditi' (not even if kept under control) is wrong: under control they are allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Animals under control are allowed
